name: Rabbit
summary: Ears up, eyes closed, sitting and waiting for the story.
text:
Sitting upright, long ears raised, eyes shut. Tall and narrow, so it fits a small shelf or a bedside table without taking the whole surface.

Painted white, with the inside of the ears in a soft pink.

options.name: Power
options.help: Batteries are not included. The mains version comes with a remote: on, off, dimmer, timer and a slow pulse.

options.name: Laser engraving
options.help: A name, a date or a short phrase, burned into the wood. Leave it empty if you would rather not.
